source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of recognizing threats (PDF 189).

blocks.text: Threats pehchanne ka matlab hai mumkina online khatron ko pehchanna, jaise:

items: Phishing Scams: Yeh dhoke ki koshishein hain jin mein koi bharose wala idara ban kar sensitive maloomat haasil ki jati hai. Misal: Un emails se hoshiyar rahein jo kisi jaane pehchane idare ki “fauri darkhwast” ke bahane personal details maangti hain.

Malware: Malicious (nuqsan deh) software jo aap ke computer ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai ya data chura sakta hai. Misal: Na-qabil-e-bharosa jagahon se software download na karein aur apna antivirus software update rakhein.

blocks.prompt: Malware kya hai, aur is ka khatra kaise kam karein?
blocks.explanation: Nuqsan deh software jo computer ko kharab karta ya data churata hai. Software sirf bharose wali jagah se download karein aur antivirus update rakhein.

items: Khatre pehchanein: phishing scams (fauri darkhwast wali emails), malware (na-qabil-e-bharosa downloads; antivirus update).
